name: Have you considered threat intelligence and the history of previous attacks on the organisation (or similar organisations) as part of the threat assessment?
conditionsText:
Applies when:
- Producing or updating threat assessments.
- Identifying likely attackers.
- Assessing threat levels.
requirementTitle: Have you considered threat intelligence and the history of previous attacks on the organisation (or similar organisations) as part of the threat assessment?
requirementDescription: Have you looked at real-world evidence about attacks that have already happened, either to your organisation or to similar organisations?
why:
Threat assessments should be evidence-based rather than based on assumptions.
The guidance states that threat assessments should use:
- Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI)
- Reputable intelligence sources
- Research into previous attacks on the organisation
- Research into attacks against similar organisations

actions.description:
You should demonstrate consideration of:
• Internal security incident history.
• Cyber Threat Intelligence reports.
• NCSC threat reporting.
• Industry intelligence feeds.
• Lessons learned from similar organisations.
• Known attacker tactics and techniques.
